pr_title: [CI] support daily image and A5 build
source_quote: RUN 块在 Dockerfile、Dockerfile.a3、Dockerfile.a3.openEuler、Dockerfile.a5、Dockerfile.a5.openEuler 和 Dockerfile.openEuler 中反复出现重复。torch-npu 块在 Dockerfile.310p 和 Dockerfile.310p.openEuler 中也被重复定义。如果 URL 模式或版本逻辑发生变化，需要更新 6-8 个文件。建议：将其提取为共享的 shell 脚本（例如 scripts/install_daily_deps.sh），然后在所有 Dockerfile 中执行 COPY + RUN。

correspondence.patch_snippet: 评后sha c6e124b 体现修改

rule.description: 当相同的依赖安装 RUN 块在多个 Dockerfile 中重复出现时，应抽离为单一共享 shell 脚本（如 `scripts/install_daily_deps.sh`），各 Dockerfile 通过 `COPY` + `bash` 调用，避免 URL/版本变更时需同步修改 6-8 个文件。
checkpoints: 检查多个 Dockerfile 是否存在高度重复的 RUN 安装块（仅架构/版本差异）
抽离为共享脚本并通过模式参数（如 `DAILY_DEPS_MODE`）区分差异
各 Dockerfile 统一 `COPY` 脚本并 `bash` 执行，构建后清理临时文件

# Dockerfile.a5.openEuler、Dockerfile.openEuler 中各重复一遍（L110-140）：
RUN if [ "$BUILD_TYPE" = "daily" ]; then \
        echo "Building daily version with extra packages..." && \
        echo "Install memfabric_hybrid based on architecture..." && \
        if [ "$(uname -m)" = "x86_64" ]; then \
            MEMFABRIC_URL="https://...x86_64...whl"; \
        else \
            MEMFABRIC_URL="https://...aarch64...whl"; \
        fi && \
        python3 -m pip install "$MEMFABRIC_URL" --force-reinstall --no-deps && \
        echo "Install memcache_hybrid..." && \
        python3 -m pip install "$MEMCACHE_URL" --force-reinstall --no-deps && \
        echo "Install triton-ascend..." && \
        python3 -m pip install "$TRITON_ASCEND_URL" --force-reinstall --no-deps && \
        echo "Install torch-npu..." && \
        wget -O /tmp/torch_npu.tar.gz "$TORCH_NPU_URL" && \
        python3 -m pip install /tmp/torch_npu/*.whl --force-reinstall --no-deps; \
    fi

pattern.code:
#!/bin/bash
# .github/workflows/scripts/install_daily_deps.sh
# 单一来源，按 DAILY_DEPS_MODE 区分 full / torch_npu_only
set -euo pipefail

if [ "$BUILD_TYPE" != "daily" ]; then exit 0; fi

ARCH=$(uname -m)

if [ "${DAILY_DEPS_MODE:-full}" = "torch_npu_only" ]; then
    # 310p 变体只装 torch-npu
    mkdir -p /tmp/torch_npu
    wget --retry-connrefused --tries=5 --timeout=30 --waitretry=10 \
        -O /tmp/torch_npu/torch_npu.tar.gz "$TORCH_NPU_URL"
    tar -xzf /tmp/torch_npu/torch_npu.tar.gz -C /tmp/torch_npu
    python3 -m pip install /tmp/torch_npu/*.whl --force-reinstall --no-deps
    rm -rf /tmp/torch_npu
    exit 0
fi

# full 模式：memfabric / memcache / triton-ascend / torch-npu 全装
if [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then
    MEMFABRIC_URL="https://...x86_64...whl"
else
    MEMFABRIC_URL="https://...aarch64...whl"
fi
python3 -m pip install "$MEMFABRIC_URL" --force-reinstall --no-deps
python3 -m pip install "$MEMCACHE_URL" --force-reinstall --no-deps
python3 -m pip install "$TRITON_ASCEND_URL" --force-reinstall --no-deps
# ... torch-npu 同上 ...
pattern.context: !/bin/bash .github/workflows/scripts/install_daily_deps.sh 单一来源，按 DAILY_DEPS_MODE 区分 full / torch_npu_only
